| ✅  | Before/after screenshots now show a very long name breaking the pill, then truncated |
| ✅  | Explained how this PR relates to #39049, #39829 and #39768 |
| ✅  | Truncating normal names: max-width changed from 150px to 15em (new push) |
| ℹ️  | The two new commits are fix-ups ("fix: increase max-width…", "css(reactions): avoid animating font-weight…"). They should be squashed into the main commit, per commit discipline. |
| ℹ️  | The font-weight change is not related to the issue, and the diff is +59/-29 for what is described as a minimal change. |
| ℹ️  | #39768 is already in "maintainer review" (assigned to evykassirer) for the same issue. |

###### Next step

Keep "not ready" and ask the author to squash the fix-up commits and explain or drop the font-weight change.

###### Reply

```quote
Thanks for the update, @Srijansarkar17! Please squash the two follow-up commits into the main commit so each commit is a coherent idea, following the [commit discipline guide](https://zulip.readthedocs.io/en/latest/contributing/commit-discipline.html). Also, please explain the font-weight change in the diff or remove it, since it doesn't look related to this issue.
```
